title: PotatoWallet
tagline: This is a proof of concent of generating ethereum wallet and recover it.
description:
One of the pain points of users is accessing web3 decentralized apps. To help bring dapps to users, this while strives to be an easy to use web interface. It allows users to 
 - create a wallet
 - check balance
 - sign transactions
 - connect to web3 apps

This is a proof of concent of generating ethereum wallet and recover it.
how_its_made: This project uses various APIs and web libraries to connect to exchanges and other web3 technologies. Mostly this proof of concept chrome extension uses the ethers js library to generate ethereum wallets and recover it. It uses ReactJS as the framework and bootstrap 5 as the HTML/CSS/JS for the web pages.
